title: Sweet Potato and Lentil Curry with Halloumi
description: A spiced sweet potato, lentil and pepper curry simmered in tomatoes, topped with grilled halloumi.
ingredients: 2 red chillies, deseeded and finely chopped
3 sweet peppers (red, orange or yellow), deseeded and sliced
400g (14oz) can of green lentils, drained and rinsed
SPICE MIX: 2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp garam masala, 2 tsp ground turmeric, 1 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp salt
steps: Prepare the spice mix by mixing all the ingredients together in a small bowl.
Spray a large flameproof and ovenproof dish (with a lid) with oil and fry the onion for 8 minutes until translucent and softly golden.

Add the garlic, chillies and peppers and fry for 5 minutes. Add the spice mix and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato purée, hot stock, lentils and sweet potato. Stir, place the lid on and simmer gently for 40 minutes.
Stir the curry. If very liquid, increase the heat and bubble hard for a couple of minutes to evaporate liquid.

Preheat a grill to its highest setting. Remove pot from heat, place the halloumi over the top. Place under the hot grill for 8-10 minutes until brown and bubbling. Sprinkle chilli flakes before serving.
notes: Great way to use up leftover roast meat — add in step 3 after the curry has been bubbling for 30 minutes. Fresh chicken breast, lamb leg steaks or frying beef also work.
